title: argyranthemum adauctum subsp. gracile
intro: Argyranthemum adauctum subsp. gracile, commonly known as the Dwarf or small marguerite, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family. Research suggests that this plant has potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Argyranthemum adauctum subsp. gracile include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are thought to include sesquiterpene lactones, although further research is needed to confirm the specific compounds involved.
